LTO-10.status: Current generation. Only full-height drives on the market; no half-height LTO-10 drive listed at any seller checked on 2026-10-23 (Symply had expected HH in Q2 2026, the LTO Program said late 2026). Tape4Backup LTO-10 drive collection is empty. 30TB media broadly in stock; 40TB media: Fujifilm in stock at MagStor and Tape4Backup (limited) but special order at TapeandMedia; Quantum 40TB limited stock at Tape4Backup, pre-order at TapeandMedia. 30TB WORM out of stock at Tape4Backup (all four brands). IBM 40TB cartridges (models 564/664, 20- and 5-packs) became available 2026-03-06 per IBM announcement; no street price seen.
LTO-10.notes: LTO-10 drives cannot read or write older LTO generations. driveInternal: no bare internal standalone LTO-10 drive price found at HPE/IBM/Quantum resellers checked; only library add-on drives (e.g. Qualstar Q-Series LTO-10 SAS FH add-on 800-0110-0 at $28,068 on BackupWorks, up from $23,509 in September). No HPE StoreEver LTO-10 standalone drive or price found. The 40TB cartridge needs an LTO-10 drive (existing FH drives accept it; IBM says its 40TB cartridges work only in IBM LTO-10 drives). LTO-10 40TB WORM: not found. WORM range uses out-of-stock prices because no 30TB WORM cartridge was in stock at the sellers checked.

marketNotes.text: October 2026 (seen 2026-10-23): Quantum standalone drives repriced upward. BackupWorks: LTO-8 TD-L82AN-BR $5,635 to $6,763, LTO-9 TD-L92AN-BR $8,480 to $10,191, LTO-9 tabletop TD-L92BN-AR $9,883 to $11,863 (about +20%). LTO World: TD-L92AN-BR $7,699 to $9,989.99, TD-L82BN-AR $5,499 to $7,659.99 (about +30-40%). Symply desktop drives at BackupWorks rose 6-21%; MagStor drive prices were unchanged at BackupWorks, LTO World and MagStor.

October 2026 (seen 2026-10-23): HPE StoreEver drives up at TapeandMedia: LTO-8 BC023A external $8,330 to $10,433, LTO-8 BC022A internal $7,695 to $8,985, LTO-9 BC042A external $13,385 to $15,225 (BC040A internal slightly down, $13,500 to $13,329).

October 2026 (seen 2026-10-23): cartridge prices mostly flat, with small rises at two sellers. BackupWorks LTO-9 HPE Q2079A $98.50 to $107.50 and IBM $104.50 to $115; its LTO-10 30TB singles rose to $275-$285 (from $263.25-$295) and Fujifilm 40TB to $535. TapeandMedia raised HPE LTO-9 Q2079A from $94.95 to $102.95. Tape4Backup, LTO World and MagStor media prices were unchanged or within a few dollars.

Tape4Backup still shows its banner on 2026-10-23: 'From September 1st, 2026, all LTO Tape prices have increased.' Its single-cartridge prices moved little since 2026-09-17 (LTO-9 $92.45-$105.99, LTO-10 30TB $259-$289), but its 30TB LTO-10 WORM cartridges and LTO-10 20-packs are now all out of stock.

Trend vs early 2026 (updated 2026-10-23): LTO-9 cartridges flat (Symply quoted about $94 in Feb 2026; now $92-$129). LTO-10 30TB roughly flat (Symply ~$280 in Feb 2026; now $259-$300). LTO-10 40TB below the expected launch price (Symply expected ~$570 or $14.25/TB; now $491-$555 or $12.28-$13.88/TB). Symply blamed the 40TB premium on launch pricing, tight Aramid base film supply and hyperscaler deals.

DatacenterDisk (published 2026-08-17, data updated 2026-09-17): LTO tape 'largely stable at $4-$6/TB' while HDD prices rose sharply in 2026; tape's $/TB edge over HDD widened from about 2x to 3.5x. The stated reason is an independent supply chain (Fujifilm and Sony in Japan) that avoids the NAND shortage and hyperscale HDD demand.

LTO Program (Sept 2026): 160.3 EB of LTO capacity shipped in 2025 (down 9% from the 176.5 EB record in 2024); Q1 2026 shipped capacity up 57% YoY, driven by LTO-9 adoption and the LTO-10 ramp; 2026 expected to set a new record.

The Register (2026-09-02): only Sony and Fujifilm make LTO cartridges. Analyst Tom Coughlin tied the 2025 dip to 'the evolving international trade environment' making buyers more cautious (tariff-related caution, but no price figure given).
Blocks & Files (2026-09-04): suggests the 2025 dip may reflect buyers waiting for LTO-10; projects 2026 could reach about 251.67 EB if Q1 pace holds.

Fujifilm LTO Ultrium 10 40TB cartridge (16978170) uses an aramid base film and began shipping January 2026; it works in existing LTO-10 drives. IBM 40TB cartridges (models 564/664) available 2026-03-06.

Half-height LTO-10 drives: Symply support article said HH drives expected Q2 2026 (FH first because of the new head guide assembly). No HH LTO-10 drive was listed at any seller checked on 2026-09-17 or 2026-10-23.

Not found / blocked (unchanged 2026-10-23): Amazon, B&H, CDW, Connection, HPE Store, eBay, ServerSupply and several refurb sites returned 403 or showed no price, so big-box and used-market prices are missing. A Fujifilm camera price increase (Aug-Sep 2026) turned up in searches but is unrelated to LTO media; no Fujifilm LTO price-increase notice for 2026 was found (the last confirmed one was July 2024: +15% LTO-9, +40% LTO-7/8).
